maya: Quick heads-up — PR #45231 is passing CI and ready for merge but we need runtime + infra + security sign-off before the canary tonight. Who can own rollback and the actual merge window? cc @sam @jordan @lena

sam: I can own rollback. I need a concise rollback playbook and the canary window (UTC). Also, do we have a perf snapshot after the kv-cache tweak?

jordan: I can take infra ownership for the merge. No DB migrations here, right? Also will check the autoscaler tweaks for burst behavior.

lena: Security checks done for KMS usage — small policy nit in the snippet, will post suggested change. :thumbsup: No blocking issues.

maya: Thanks — no DB migrations. Canary window proposal: 02:00–03:00 UTC tonight. Rollback playbook (quick):
```
# rollback steps
1) block new traffic to canary pool: `redwoodctl traffic block --pool canary`
2) scale canary to 0: `redwoodctl scale --pool canary --replicas 0`
3) restore previous model-version tag on routing: `redwoodctl routing set default --model my-model:v42`
4) monitor latency/errors for 5m: `redwoodctl monitor --route /generate --window 5m`
```
I'll add the playbook to the PR description in a minute.

ci-bot: CI summary: all tests passed (unit/integration), perf-regression check: +0.7% median latency on canary profile (acceptable). Artifact: s3://redwood-ci/artifacts/pr-45231/

sam: OK I'll be on call for rollback during 01:45–03:15 UTC. Jordan, can you confirm infra won't auto-evict canary nodes during the window?

jordan: I'll pin the canary nodes and set eviction throttle. Will post the exact commands in the PR comments. If anyone sees anything unexpected, ping me in this thread.
